title: xls or xlsx from the extension and the signature

origin.description: xls or xlsx from the extension and the signature.
origin.details: The extension wins when it is xls or xlsx. Otherwise the leading bytes are consulted when the file exists.

translation.example:
from readxl import excel_format, readxl_example
files = ["a.xlsx", "b.xls", "c.png", "/etc/hostname", readxl_example("clippy.xlsx"), readxl_example("deaths.xls")]
print("|".join("NA" if item is None else item for item in excel_format(files)))
